reason: After the authenticated schema-valid PASS was produced, independent governance analysis identified unqualified review-evidence and trust-boundary mechanisms: non-file evidence refs can be declared but silently omitted from corpus materialization; blind-review metadata can coexist with proposer identity/conclusion exposure; the mutable candidate branch supplies the review runner/corpus builder; merge-base is resolved at execution time so retries may observe different corpus state; candidate evidence is embedded as untrusted LLM input without a qualified prompt-injection boundary; reviewer evidence citations are not yet machine-grounded to frozen hashed objects.
